nodes.Name: GenerateWebProject
nodes.DocComment:
GenerateWebProject writes a complete, buildable web project under frontend/.
It assumes the Phase 0.3/Phase 2 type + client files (frontend/src/types/*,
frontend/src/api/client.ts, frontend/tsconfig.json) are generated alongside;
this fills in package.json, the Vite config, index.html, the entry point, and
a small typed App that consumes the generated client so the whole tree
type-checks and bundles.

nodes.Name: webPackageJSON
nodes.DocComment:
pinned, dependency-light Vite + React + TS. No router dep (the loose
AppRouter.jsx fragment used react-router-dom, but the buildable App below
renders entity lists directly so the project type-checks with only react +
react-dom + the build toolchain — fewer moving parts, deterministic install).

nodes.Name: webViteConfig
webIndexHTML

nodes.Name: webMainTSX
webAppTSX
nodes.DocComment:
webAppTSX builds a typed App that imports the generated entity types and the
typed API client, listing each entity. It matches the EXACT Phase 2 client
contract: the client exports a per-entity object `<lcFirst>Api` with a
`.list()` method, and the types barrel exports `<Entity>` (original-case
name). Verified against frontend/typescript.go GenerateAPIClient.

nodes.Name: webTSConfigFallback
nodes.DocComment:
Fallback strict tsconfig if Phase 2's GenerateTSConfig didn't run. Mirrors the
Phase 2 config: strict, no emit, bundler resolution, no @types/node needed.
nodes.ValueLiteral:
`{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2020",
    "useDefineForClassFields": true,
    "lib": ["ES2020", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"],
    "module": "ESNext",
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "allowImportingTsExtensions": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "noEmit": true,
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "strict": true,
    "noUnusedLocals": true,
    "noUnusedParameters": true,
    "noFallthroughCasesInSwitch": true,
    "types": []
  },
  "include": ["src"],
  "references": [{ "path": "./tsconfig.node.json" }]
}
`

nodes.Name: GenerateDockerfile
nodes.DocComment:
GenerateDockerfile writes a multi-stage Dockerfile that builds the Go backend
static binary and runs it on a minimal base. Offline-friendly: the build
stage uses the vendored module; no network needed at image-build time beyond
the base images. The actual `docker build` is a verify-on-box step (no daemon
in this sandbox).

nodes.Name: dockerfileContents
nodes.ValueLiteral:
`# Multi-stage build for the generated Go backend.
# Stage 1 compiles a static linux/amd64 binary; stage 2 is a minimal runtime.
FROM golang:1.25-bookworm AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY backend/ ./backend/
WORKDIR /src/backend
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o /out/server .

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /out/server /app/server
EXPOSE 8080
USER nonroot:nonroot
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/server"]
`
